caseName: Clairol, Inc. v. Director of Division of Taxation
caseNameFull: Clairol, Inc. v. Director of Division of Taxation

opinions.text: Appeal from Sup. Ct. N. J. Motion of Automobile Manufacturers Assn., Inc., for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Appeal dismissed for want of substantial federal question. Mr. Justice Harlan is of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted and case set for oral argument. Mr. Justice Brennan took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
